description.value: Eternal Abundance is a 100% organic, fully vegan market and café on Commercial Drive in Vancouver, one of the city's most cycling-friendly corridors. The market stocks an impressive range of whole foods including local and farm-direct produce, bulk dry goods, superfoods, artisan vegan cheeses, and organic spices — with a zero-waste ethos using returnable glass jars and compostable packaging. The attached café serves an entirely organic, vegan, and gluten-friendly menu with call-ahead and DoorDash delivery options.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (4 spaces) at 38m; rack at 90m; rack at 91m. Total: 4 spaces.
